reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Make sure EbsOptimizedInfo exists when selecting instances by EBS maximum bandwidth (#6663) #6663 (Nicole Wren)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Environments that select instances by EBS maximum bandwidth will no longer encounter failures caused by missing EbsOptimizedInfo.
consequence.remediation: No action required; upgrade to v1.0.0 to receive the bug fix.

proposed.statement: Karpenter now ensures EbsOptimizedInfo exists when selecting instances by EBS maximum bandwidth, fixing a bug that could occur when this information was missing.
